title: Production Deployment and Optimization
description: Model quantization, TFLite, TF Serving, TFX pipelines, MLOps practices, monitoring, and edge deployment.
objectives: Optimize models with quantization and pruning
Set up TF Serving for production
keyTakeaways: Post-training quantization converts float32 weights to int8, shrinking model size ~4x and speeding inference on CPU/edge
TFLite = flatbuffer model format optimized for mobile/edge; delegate to GPU or NNAPI for hardware acceleration
TF Serving exposes a model as a gRPC/REST API with zero-downtime model versioning via SavedModel
TFX pipeline stages (ExampleGen → Transform → Trainer → Evaluator → Pusher) automate the full ML lifecycle
Data and concept drift are production failure modes; monitor prediction distribution and label quality continuously
